sources.title: qwen-flash Model Info (international documentation; updated October 11, 2026)
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Both the qwen-flash alias and its July 28, 2025 snapshot have capability, context, pricing and rate-limit tables. The alias is explicitly functionally equivalent to that snapshot. No total or active parameter count, dense/MoE specification, or named-base lineage appears; table headings called Parameter refer to context and request limits.

name.note: Normalized display name for the documented Qwen-Flash hosted model.

family.note: Qwen3 member within the broader Qwen family.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit availability in the reviewed official release log: International and Global on August 1; Beijing on August 5. Baseline July 28 is the snapshot date.

open_weights.note: Official commercial-edition classification supports retaining false; no exact-model weight release was established.

license.note: No downloadable-weight license is identified for this commercial model; do not inherit an open Qwen checkpoint license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh review of the exact alias/snapshot cards, release log and thinking guide found no developer-published nominal total or explicit relationship to a named base model. Searches for qwen-flash and the dated snapshot in English and Chinese did not establish additional first-party size evidence. Qwen3 family membership alone cannot support inheriting an open checkpoint count.

active_parameters_b.note: No active parameter count or named-base lineage is published for qwen-flash or qwen-flash-2025-07-28 in the refreshed sources. Its dense/MoE architecture also remains undisclosed; counts belonging to separately identified open Qwen3 or later numbered Flash models do not apply.

architecture.note: Reviewed exact-model documentation does not identify dense/MoE architecture.

context_window.note: Context window, distinct from the 997952-token maximum input.

reasoning.note: Optional hybrid thinking; disabled by default.

tool_call.note: Supported-model guide and Beijing table confirm support. Exact-model tables mark Singapore, Frankfurt and Virginia unsupported; retain capability with regional qualification, not universal availability.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3 text model with optional thinking and a one-million-token context window.
description.note: Replaces unsourced workload and speed positioning with documented capabilities.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3 text model with optional thinking and a one-million-token context window.
patch.notes: The qwen-flash alias is functionally equivalent to qwen-flash-2025-07-28. Official availability began August 1, 2025 (International/Global), August 5 (Beijing). Total/active parameters and architecture are undisclosed; no explicit named-base lineage supports a size inference. Later numbered Flash models are separate entries. Function calling is documented generally and for Beijing, but other exact-model regional tables mark it unsupported.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains undisclosed total and active counts after reopening exact-model primary documentation and searching for nominal counts and named-base lineage. Official sources still identify the July 2025 snapshot without a size or architecture; no supported inference links it to Qwen3-30B-A3B or later numbered Flash models.
